name: 500 RUMMY
description: Chinchón is a Spanish and Latin American rummy-family matching game closely related to Gin Rummy, where players form sets and runs and try to reduce unmatched card value or complete a seven-card run called chinchón.

content.text: Chinchón is a Spanish and Latin American rummy-family matching game closely related to Gin Rummy, where players form sets and runs and try to reduce unmatched card value or complete a seven-card run called chinchón.
Chinchón is played in Spain, Uruguay, Argentina, Cape Verde and other regions, with local names such as Txintxon, Conga, and La Conga.
2-4 players use the table arrangement described for Chinchón.
